skill.summary: Scores and improves draft social posts for viral potential.

security_audit.summary: The command-execution findings are false positives caused by TypeScript template literals and Markdown code fences. Real concerns remain: the script loads a parent .env file, reads local input files, uses API credentials, and sends content to an external model endpoint. The skill needs clear disclosure, path restrictions, and safer secret handling before broad publication.

remediation.suggestion: Do not traverse to a parent .env file. Require explicit environment variables and remove override: true unless the user opts in.

remediation.issue: Arbitrary local file reads before model submission
remediation.suggestion: Restrict processing to an approved content directory. Require confirmation before reading absolute paths or files outside that directory.

remediation.issue: Configurable model endpoint receives content and credentials
remediation.suggestion: Validate ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL against an allowlist or remove endpoint override support. Warn users when a custom endpoint is used.

remediation.issue: Output file creation lacks collision and name policy checks
remediation.suggestion: Normalize output names, handle duplicate report names, and document where generated reports are written.

remediation.issue: Prompt optimizes emotionally persuasive viral rewrites
remediation.suggestion: Add user guidance against deceptive, harassing, or manipulative campaigns. Ask users to preserve accuracy and context.

semantic_findings.title: Local File Content Sent to External Model Service
semantic_findings.description: index.ts reads a local file, builds a prompt, and submits it through the Anthropic SDK. User-provided absolute paths are allowed, so sensitive files could be disclosed if selected.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The data flow from argv file path to readFileSync and messages.create is direct. The code does not restrict user-supplied paths to SOURCE_DIR.

semantic_findings.title: Configurable Model Endpoint Can Receive Secrets and Content
semantic_findings.description: The client uses ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL as baseURL while also passing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. A custom endpoint could receive file content and credentials.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The baseURL override and API key are both passed to the SDK client. Custom endpoints can be legitimate, so confidence is high enough to flag but not absolute.

semantic_findings.title: Engagement Manipulation Guidance
semantic_findings.description: The skill asks the model to maximize viral engagement using anger, fear, surprise, and other high-arousal emotions. This can support manipulative social media messaging.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The prompt explicitly optimizes for viral potential and high-arousal emotions. It is framed as content growth, so this is a misuse-risk finding rather than clear malware.

content.value_statement: Draft posts often fail because weak hooks, pacing, or value are hard to see. This skill scores those factors and suggests sharper rewrites.
actual_capabilities: Scores draft content across curiosity, emotion, value, relevance, pacing, and novelty.
Identifies strengths and weaknesses in a Markdown report.
Suggests changes to titles, hooks, structure, and tone.
Produces a rewritten version optimized for viral social sharing.
Batch processes Markdown drafts from an outputs directory when run as a script.
limitations: Requires an Anthropic API key and network access for automated script use.
Designed for social posts and short articles, not long-form editorial review.
Scores are model judgments and should not be treated as performance guarantees.
The script reads local Markdown files and writes reports to a project output folder.

use_cases.title: Improve Launch Posts
use_cases.description: Review launch copy before posting and receive stronger hooks, clearer value, and a cleaner final draft.

use_cases.title: Audit Social Calendars
use_cases.description: Score scheduled posts and find weak drafts before they reach the publishing queue.

use_cases.title: Coach Content Writers
use_cases.description: Show writers which viral factors are missing and provide concrete revision targets.

prompt_templates.title: Score One Draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review for a single post.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this draft for viral potential. Score each factor and give three practical improvements: [paste draft].

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite With Constraints
prompt_templates.prompt: Review and rewrite this post. Keep the claim accurate, keep the tone calm, and improve the opening hook: [paste draft].

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Versions
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these two drafts. Explain which version has stronger viral factors, then create a final merged version: [paste drafts].

prompt_templates.title: Batch Review Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these drafts as a campaign set. Rank them, identify repeated weaknesses, and suggest a revision plan: [paste drafts].

output_examples.input: A short product launch post about a new analytics dashboard.
output_examples.output: The report scores the hook as weak, improves the opening question, and rewrites the post with clearer business value.

output_examples.input: A founder thread about lessons from a failed hiring process.
output_examples.output: The skill highlights strong narrative tension, suggests tighter pacing, and produces a more direct final version.

output_examples.input: A batch of Markdown drafts in the configured outputs folder.
output_examples.output: The script creates verification reports in the viral-verified-posts output folder for unprocessed drafts.

best_practices: Provide the full draft and explain the target audience before asking for a rewrite.
Review factual claims after every rewrite before publishing.
Use scores as editing signals, not as guaranteed engagement predictions.
anti_patterns: Do not use the rewrite to exaggerate claims or remove important context.
Do not process confidential drafts without approval for external model use.
Do not optimize for outrage when the topic requires accuracy and care.

faq.question: What does this skill evaluate?
faq.answer: It evaluates curiosity, emotion, value, relevance, pacing, and novelty in draft social content.

faq.question: Does it guarantee viral performance?
faq.answer: No. It provides model-based editing guidance, but audience response depends on many external factors.

faq.question: Can it rewrite my post?
faq.answer: Yes. The core prompt asks for a final optimized version after scoring and diagnosis.

faq.question: Does the script use local files?
faq.answer: Yes. The automation reads Markdown drafts from local paths and writes Markdown reports to an output folder.

faq.question: Does automated use require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The script uses the Anthropic SDK and reads Anthropic configuration from environment variables.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: The marketplace metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
